acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce or refute each of the three observations on a scratch clone; for each reproduced one, a regression test shows dogfood-finish naming the failing step/code (no silent exit), and a citation-plan-binding from a superseded map yielding a stale-binding diagnostic instead of citation-plan-map-mismatch.
body: suspected: Observed 2026-10-15 by the docs batch lane (PR #913, branch claude/docs-batch-1357-1372-1350, base 32c57367d, darwin, host load 60-180). (1) One `make dogfood-finish` run exited without output and left an empty log, so the failing step was not identifiable. (2) After amending the change commit, a leftover .git/corvint/citation-plan-binding from the earlier run produced citation-plan-map-mismatch against the new map until the file was removed. (3) Removing the sidecar mid-run (operator error) produced 'cannot read CEM map' without naming the missing path. Expected: every dogfood-finish exit names its failing step and code; a binding left from a previous map is detected as stale and reported as such (or ignored), not as a mismatch.
title: suspected: dogfood-finish exits silently with an empty log, and a stale citation-plan-binding file reports a false citation-plan-map-mismatch after an amend
